# Workshop Outputs

This folder will contain deliverables and outcomes from the OK Contract Renewal roadmap planning workshop.
page_texts.3:
[strategy/workshops/sessions/roadmap-planning/ok-contract-renewal-20251104/outputs/README.md#primary-outputs]

### Primary Outputs

- **Roadmap Document** - Strategic roadmap for contract renewal initiative
- **Decision Record** - Key decisions made during the workshop
- **Action Plan** - Specific action items with owners and timelines
- **Risk Register** - Identified risks and mitigation strategies
page_texts.4:
[strategy/workshops/sessions/roadmap-planning/ok-contract-renewal-20251104/outputs/README.md#supporting-materials]

### Supporting Materials

- **Meeting Notes** - Detailed notes from workshop sessions
- **Stakeholder Commitments** - Documented stakeholder agreements and commitments
- **Timeline Overview** - Visual timeline of key milestones and dependencies
- **Success Metrics** - Defined success criteria and measurement approach
page_texts.6:
[strategy/workshops/sessions/roadmap-planning/ok-contract-renewal-20251104/outputs/README.md#immediate-within-48-hours]

### Immediate (Within 48 hours)

- [ ] Finalize and distribute meeting notes
- [ ] Send action plan to all participants
- [ ] Schedule follow-up meetings as needed
- [ ] Update project management tools with action items
page_texts.7:
[strategy/workshops/sessions/roadmap-planning/ok-contract-renewal-20251104/outputs/README.md#short-term-within-1-week]

### Short-term (Within 1 week)

- [ ] Refine roadmap document based on workshop feedback
- [ ] Begin implementation of quick wins identified
- [ ] Establish regular progress review meetings
- [ ] Communicate key outcomes to broader stakeholder group
page_texts.8:
[strategy/workshops/sessions/roadmap-planning/ok-contract-renewal-20251104/outputs/README.md#long-term-ongoing]

### Long-term (Ongoing)

- [ ] Track progress against roadmap milestones
- [ ] Conduct regular risk assessments
- [ ] Maintain stakeholder alignment through updates
- [ ] Measure success against defined criteria

---

**Note**: This folder will be populated during and after the workshop session on November 4, 2025.
